repo_notes: ULTIMATE self-learning red team monorepo. All submodules replaced with real source code. Continuously discovers and archives EVERY exploit/PoC/tool from GitHub. Extracts live patterns daily from all fetched data and uses them for smart classification. Everything is append-only. Full history preserved forever in HISTORY.md + daily history/ + archives/ folders. Nothing is ever lost.

pages.title: Overview
pages.content: Complete architecture of the self-learning red team archive. How daily discovery, pattern extraction, classification, and append-only history work together.

pages.title: History System
pages.content: Every change is captured daily. Location of HISTORY.md, history/YYYY-MM-DD/ folders, and archives/YYYY-MM-DD/ with full file copies. Nothing from the past is ever lost.

pages.title: Classification Logic
pages.content: How the system automatically classifies new repos into exploits/, tools/, writeups/, cves/, or other/ using live patterns extracted from all existing data.

pages.title: Daily Discovery
pages.content: Ultra-aggressive GitHub-wide search (1000 results per query, 20+ search terms). How new PoCs are found and added every day.

pages.title: Self-Learning System
pages.content: How the monorepo gets smarter every day by extracting patterns (file extensions, README phrases, structures) from everything it has already fetched.

pages.title: Core Tools (Real Source Code)
pages.content: Actual source code of Exploit-DB, nuclei-templates, Metasploit, Impacket, Covenant, Empire, Sliver, PayloadsAllTheThings and all frameworks (no submodules).

pages.title: Discovered PoCs Structure
pages.content: discovered-pocs/ with subfolders exploits/, tools/, writeups/, cves/, other/. How new repos are automatically organized.

pages.title: Official Feeds
pages.content: NVD CVE, CISA KEV, and MITRE ATT&CK feeds updated daily.
